title: Bobby Darrin - Somewhere Beyond the Sea

lines.l: Out of the sun, whatever made me think that I was number one, I ought to know.
I'm sitting it out, I'm spinning the dial.
Just thinking about the chump I've been, I have to smile.
Didn't I know, easy come and easy go
She wasn't kind, I wasn't smart
I lost my mind and fell apart
I had to find myself in time
Now I can start all over again
And I still can smile and pick the show
Is it come? Is it go?
She wasn't kind, I wasn't smart
I lost my mind, I fell apart
I had to find myself in time
Now I can start all over again
